g.text: Джон Роберт Кинг,Ричард Ли Байерс,Пол Б Томпсон,Кевин Т Стейн,Том Льюпольд,Лорен Коулмен,Вэнс Мур,Джонатан
On a world supported on the back of a giant turtle (sex unknown), a gleeful, explosive, wickedly eccentric expedition sets out. There’s an
avaricious but inept wizard, a naive tourist whose luggage moves on hundreds of dear little legs, dragons who only exist if you believe in
them, and of course THE EDGE of the planet…
The wackiest and most original fantasy since
Annotations collected and edited by Leo Breebaarted at
